title.narrative: Multitranche Financing Facility (MFF) - North Eastern State Roads Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The project comprises (a) Investment Component consisting of improvements of about 200 km state roads in the States of Assam, Meghalaya and Sikkim, and associated consulting services for construction supervision; and (b) Project Management and Capacity Development Component consisting of (i) assistance to the Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (MDONER) and the public works departments (PWDs) in implementing the Investment Subprojects, and (ii) capacity development of the PWDs for improved road asset management.
